title: Quantum Secret Sharing from CSS qLDPC Codes: Computable Access Structures, Accessible Logical Dimension, and Topology-Aware Network Cost
summary: Quantum secret sharing (QSS) schemes can be constructed from quantum error-correcting codes, but characterizing their access structures and implementation costs becomes challenging for finite-length, high-rate quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes. We develop an exact computational framework for QSS induced by CSS qLDPC codes.
